heroIntro: Get your boots on the ground with council member {councilName} and {influencerName} on a three stop tour to experience the nightlife and support local businesses while building a relationship with your council member.
councilQuote: This isn't just about nightlife; it's about connecting with the community where they are. We're breaking down the walls of City Hall.
influencerQuote: District {district} has some of the most vibrant, unsung spots in the city. I can't wait to show everyone what makes this neighborhood tick.

stops.title: {influencerName}'s St. Roch Start
stops.body: The night kicks off in {location} at a spot {influencerName} wants more people to know�local flavor, strong community ties, and the energy that keeps this corridor moving.

stops.title: {councilName}'s Gentilly Classic
stops.body: Stop two is Councilmember {councilName}'s pick: a Gentilly institution where longtime residents and newcomers can share a table and talk about what the ward needs next.

stops.title: The District D Vote
stops.body: Vote for the venue that should close out the crawl. The winner in {location} becomes our third stop when District D hits the street on March 26.
